sql:
/*
首日 cohort 的在线时长与强制新手引导漏斗：SG 基准改用 5/9，避开 5/8 已知 bug。
引导步骤使用 guide_id + gamer_skip，维表顺序为 COALESCE(extra_id,0)，仅保留 <=46。
*/
WITH TCB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SGA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
C AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#distinct_id" did,e."#account_id" aid,e."$part_date" d FROM ta.v_event_18 e WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TCB b WHERE b.u=e."#user_id") GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',e."#distinct_id",e."#account_id",e."$part_date" FROM ta.v_event_13 e JOIN SGC c ON e."#user_id"=c.u JOIN SGA a ON e."#user_id"=a.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"='2026-05-09' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SGB b WHERE b.u=e."#user_id") GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
 UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)',e."#distinct_id",e."#account_id",e."$part_date" FROM ta.v_event_13 e JOIN SGC c ON e."#user_id"=c.u WHERE e."$part_event"='new_role' AND e."$part_date"='2026-05-09' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SGB b WHERE b.u=e."#user_id") GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
G AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,g."#distinct_id" did,CAST(g.gamer_guide_id AS VARCHAR) gid,COALESCE(TRY_CAST(g.gamer_skip AS INTEGER),0) skip_flag FROM ta.v_event_18 g JOIN C c ON c.grp='繁体CBT' AND g."#distinct_id"=c.did AND g."$part_date"=c.d WHERE g."$part_event"='gamer_guide'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.grp,g."#distinct_id",CAST(g.gamer_guide_id AS VARCHAR),COALESCE(TRY_CAST(g.gamer_skip AS INTEGER),0) FROM ta.v_event_13 g JOIN C c ON c.grp<>'繁体CBT' AND g."#distinct_id"=c.did AND g."$part_date"=c.d WHERE g."$part_event"='gamer_guide'
),
D AS (SELECT CAST("gamer_guide_id@gamer_guide_id" AS VARCHAR) gid,COALESCE(TRY_CAST("gamer_guide_id@gamer_skip" AS INTEGER),0) skip_flag,COALESCE(TRY_CAST("gamer_guide_id@extra_id" AS INTEGER),0) ord,MAX("gamer_guide_id@guide_name") name FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18504 GROUP BY 1,2,3),
GA AS (SELECT g.grp,COALESCE(d.ord,0) ord,MIN(g.gid) gid,MAX(COALESCE(d.name,CONCAT('步骤ID_',g.gid,'_',CAST(g.skip_flag AS VARCHAR)))) name,COUNT(DISTINCT g.did) reached FROM G g LEFT JOIN D d ON g.gid=d.gid AND g.skip_flag=d.skip_flag WHERE COALESCE(d.ord,0)<=46 AND COALESCE(d.ord,0)<>17 AND g.gid NOT IN ('2049','2050') GROUP BY 1,2),
DurE AS (
 SELECT c.grp,c.aid,e."#event_time" et FROM C c JOIN ta.v_event_18 e ON c.grp='繁体CBT' AND e."#account_id"=c.aid WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-08-01' AND e."#event_name" NOT LIKE '%app%'
 UNION ALL SELECT c.grp,c.aid,e."#event_time" FROM C c JOIN ta.v_event_13 e ON c.grp<>'繁体CBT' AND e."#account_id"=c.aid WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',DATE '2026-07-29',DATE '2026-08-01'),DATE '2026-05-08') AS VARCHAR) AND e."#event_name" NOT LIKE '%app%'
),
U AS (SELECT c.grp,c.aid,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gap BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN gap ELSE 0 END),0)/60.0 mins FROM C c LEFT JOIN (SELECT grp,aid,DATE_DIFF('second',CAST(et AS TIMESTAMP),LEAD(CAST(et AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER(PARTITION BY grp,aid ORDER BY et)) gap FROM DurE) x ON c.grp=x.grp AND c.aid=x.aid GROUP BY 1,2),
DB AS (SELECT grp,CASE WHEN mins<5 THEN '01.<5分钟' WHEN mins<15 THEN '02.5-15分钟' WHEN mins<30 THEN '03.15-30分钟' WHEN mins<60 THEN '04.30-60分钟' ELSE '05.60分钟以上' END bucket,COUNT(*) users FROM U GROUP BY 1,2),
DS AS (SELECT grp,AVG(mins) avg_mins FROM U GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'guide' "数据模块",a.grp "对比组",a.ord "排序",CONCAT(CAST(a.ord AS VARCHAR),'.',a.name) "项目",a.reached "用户数",ROUND(100.0*a.reached/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT did) FROM C c WHERE c.grp=a.grp),0),2) "占比(%)",NULL "平均在线分钟" FROM GA a
UNION ALL SELECT 'duration',d.grp,NULL,d.bucket,d.users,ROUND(100.0*d.users/NULLIF(SUM(d.users) OVER(PARTITION BY d.grp),0),2),ROUND(s.avg_mins,2) FROM DB d JOIN DS s ON d.grp=s.grp
ORDER BY 1,2,3;
